To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a blockchain-based platform to support the exchange and management of cybersecurity information across borders, which is aligned with the current EU legislation.

the proposed blockchain platform for cross-border management of cybersecurity information is able to address the requirements of the Cybersecurity Act, and it has been implemented and evaluated in the context of a use case scenario.

1) the proposed blockchain based platform can support the realization of the EU Cybersecurity Certification Framework; 2) the platform can be deployed in different scenarios; and 3) the platform can support the exchange of information between ICT stakeholders, and the management of cybersecurity information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and development of the technical infrastructure to support the realization of a European cybersecurity certification framework.
the design and development of a blockchain-based platform to support the exchange of cybersecurity information across different ledgers and countries.
the development of a novel platform to support the cross border management of cybersecurity information, which is a prerequisite for the implementation of the EU Cybersecurity Act.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed platform is a promising approach to support the realization of the EU cybersecurity certification framework.
our proposal is a promising and feasible approach that could help the EU in its efforts toward the realization of the common cybersecurity certification framework.

the proposed blockchain platform can be used for the realization of the EU cybersecurity certification framework and can provide the needed interoperability between different cybersecurity certification schemes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our platform is a novel blockchain based approach for the cross border management of cybersecurity information.

we propose a blockchain-based platform for the management and interconnection of ledgers associated with cybersecurity information and certificates, which can be used to implement a common cybersecurity certification scheme in the EU.
our platform enables the realization of an EU-wide cybersecurity certification framework, while at the time addressing scalability and performance requirements.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a blockchain based approach is a promising way forward to enable cross border management of cybersecurity information and certification, while at the time addressing the main concerns of the EU legislation and industry stakeholders.

the proposed platform can be a key enabler to the realization of the EU cybersecurity certification framework, as it enables a secure, scalable and interoperable exchange of cybersecurity information across borders and different sectors.
blockchain technology can be a valuable asset to support the realization of cybersecurity certification at the EU level.
